In-home 10-day outpatient addiction program with counsellor Bobby Bains in South Surrey BC, plus online and 30-day live-in support. Call for intake dates.

centre.name: Gobind Wellness
centre.address: 15300 Croydon Dr #300, Surrey, BC V3Z 0Z5, Canada

about_blocks.text: Gobind Wellness is a private addiction counselling and recovery coaching practice based in South Surrey, with an office in Suite 300 at 15300 Croydon Drive and a second office in Calgary. Its founder, Bobby Bains, is an addictions counsellor and recovery coach who writes openly about his own recovery from alcohol. There are no treatment beds here. The main program is outpatient, and most of the work happens in the client's own home.

The main program is outpatient, and most of the work happens in the client's own home.

about_blocks.text: The best known service is the 10-day in-person program, 30 hours spread over 10 consecutive days. Each day Bobby spends about two hours one to one with the client, at home or in the office, then takes them to a one-hour community support meeting in the evening. The days cover triggers, the client's life story, resentments and amends, meditation, and a daily routine built around fitness, nutrition, sleep and meetings. Day 10 is a family day, when relatives go over the aftercare plan and get to say how the drinking or drug use has affected them.

about_blocks.text: For people who need closer supervision, Gobind Wellness also lists a 30-day live-in program. A recovery specialist stays with the client around the clock, either in the client's home or in one of Gobind Wellness's own accommodations, with random testing, group and one-to-one sessions, exercise, meal prep and daily meetings. It is not a licensed residential facility or a medical detox unit. The website says its staff are not doctors and asks clients to see their family physician about withdrawal before they start.

about_blocks.text: Smaller options are a 10-hour online program by Zoom, listed at $1,800 for people who are not yet drinking or using daily, and single counselling or coaching sessions at $190 an hour in person, by video or by phone. Rates for the 10-day and 30-day programs are given on request. Everything is private pay and paid at booking. Gobind Wellness does not bill insurers, though you can send your receipts to your extended health plan.

about_blocks.text: The program leans on the 12 steps and community meetings, and the spirituality it teaches is described as not religion-based. Aftercare includes an introduction to a sponsor and a home group, a 24-hour contact number and in-person check-ins at one, three and six months of sobriety. Most clients come from Surrey, White Rock, Langley, Delta and Cloverdale, and Bobby will travel elsewhere in Canada for an added charge.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Gobind Wellness

faqs.question: Is Gobind Wellness a residential rehab?

answer_blocks.text: No. Gobind Wellness is a private outpatient counselling and recovery coaching practice in South Surrey, and its main 10-day program takes place in your home or at its office while you keep living at home. It also offers a 30-day live-in option, where a recovery specialist stays with you in your home or in one of Gobind Wellness's accommodations. That option is supervised support, not a licensed residential treatment facility.

answer_blocks.text: You spend 10 consecutive days with counsellor Bobby Bains, about three hours a day and 30 hours in total. answer_blocks.text: Single counselling or recovery coaching sessions cost $190 an hour, in person or by Zoom or phone. The 10-hour online program is listed at $1,800 on the service fees page. Rates for the 10-day in-person program and the 30-day live-in program are not published, so you need to call for a quote. All sessions and programs are paid at the time of booking.

faqs.question: Is Gobind Wellness covered by insurance or Fraser Health?

answer_blocks.text: It is a private-pay service and is not publicly funded through Fraser Health. Gobind Wellness does not bill insurers directly. You pay first and can submit your receipts to your extended health plan, so check with your insurer if it covers sessions with an addictions counsellor or recovery coach.

answer_blocks.text: Bobby Bains is the founder of Gobind Wellness and leads its 10-day program as addictions counsellor and recovery coach.
